_comment: Zones the harness may START OR STOP AUDIO in. Tom's call, not Claude's.
_rules: Anything that makes noise MUST go through sonos.testing() — it mutes, then restores.
Read-only inspection (transport, queue, shares) is allowed on ANY zone.
Subs and satellites are excluded automatically — they have no AVTransport.
Zones not listed here are treated as in-use and are never touched.
UI taps in the Simulator can start real playback and NO code intercepts that — the
allowed list governs Claude's behaviour too, not just these scripts.

quiet_hours._comment: Empty by design. Tom, 2026-08-06: 'volume should be set to zero during testing. with zero volume, no hours are out of bounds.'
